purpose: Extend Gate-1 evidence so the controlled remote D1 package can prove the physical auth_session_state schema without promoting AUTH-002 or inferring runtime semantics.

referencePolicy.sessionId: logical reference to users.sessions[].id; no physical FK to embedded session element
referencePolicy.userId: physical FK only after ENT-USER schema authority is proven; otherwise logical reference

acceptance: catalog proves auth_session_state is a physical table
required columns match exactly by name/type/nullability/primary-key role
foreign-key evidence is captured and interpreted according to reference policy
evidence is bound to the tested commit and controlled remote D1 database
no native users.sessions[] shape is modified by this evidence contract
nonPromotionRule: Passing this gate proves physical schema evidence only; it does not prove native session runtime behavior, migration correctness, authorization correctness, or AUTH-002 GREEN.
